headline: Arfin India files its Regulation 74(5) certificate for the second quarter of financial year 2027.
hook: Routine compliance filing from small-cap firm
summary: Arfin India has submitted its mandatory Regulation 74(5) certificate to the stock exchanges for the quarter ended September 2027. The certificate, issued by the registrar and share transfer agent, confirms the details of securities dematerialised or rematerialised during the period. Such filings are standard regulatory requirements for listed companies to ensure transparency in shareholding records. For an Indian retail investor, this is routine compliance paperwork with no direct bearing on the company's financial performance or stock price.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with zero impact on stock price.
